fusions.name: Pinpoint Pitch
fusions.desc: Throws a stone for 30 damage that always lands as a critical hit and leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Threat Stare
fusions.desc: Stares down everything in a cone 5 tiles long, dealing 8 damage, stunning it for 1 second, with a 60% chance to leave each target [Weakened] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Weak Spot Found
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sized Up
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your critical chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
